name: Amber Chamber
address: Bang Jo hills, Si Sunthon, Thalang, Phuket
shortDescription: A small hillside collection of private-pool villas in Bang Jo, Si Sunthon, with 3 and 4-bedroom homes.
description: Amber Chamber is a small hillside collection of private-pool villas in the Bang Jo area of Si Sunthon, Thalang, in northwest Phuket. The project comprises 3 and 4-bedroom homes of roughly 428 to 620 sqm built-up across the Essence, Serenity and Bliss designs. Listings describe it as under construction, with shared co-working, fitness and pet areas plus round-the-clock security. Unit counts, prices and handover timing differ between marketing sources.
researchNotes: Completion conflict: Papaya says Q3 2026, PropertyScout says 2028 (still under construction as of 2026-11-14 check). Ownership conflict: Papaya says Leasehold, PropertyScout says Freehold; only Papaya recorded. Unit count conflict: 18 (Papaya) vs 16 (PropertyScout). Keller Henson not found. Developer 2 Thanwa Property per Papaya/PropertyScout/Realting; Vera Visio appears only as the agency brand. 4BR Bliss page mentions terrace 722 sqm, not confirmed as land. Serenity bathrooms not given. | From THB 35.1M for 3BR Essence per Papaya Property; PropertyScout shows THB 34.4M-51.3M and Lazudi 32.5M-49.3M, so prices vary by source.
